vendor.blurb: Europe's sovereign AI: skips the frontier race, sells open weights and private deploys

mistral-medium-3-5.tagline: One model merging Devstral and Magistral
highlights: Merges the Devstral 2 coding line and Magistral reasoning line, with adjustable effort
AA Intelligence Index 14, Text Arena #113, Code Arena #118
mistral-medium-3-5.notes: Modified MIT license (high-revenue companies must use paid channels); powers the Vibe remote coding agent. Sources date the release 4/29 or 4/30.

mistral-small-4.tagline: Instruct, reasoning, coding in one small model
highlights: Apache 2.0; 128 experts, only 4 active per token
One model for instruct, reasoning and coding, with image input

mistral-large-3.tagline: Europe's biggest open model, DeepSeek V3 inside
highlights: Raschka's teardown: reuses DeepSeek V3 architecture, half the experts, each twice as big
mistral-large-3.notes: No Large 4 yet; the flagship role has effectively passed to Medium 3.5.

devstral-2.tagline: A Small coding model that runs on a laptop
highlights: Small 2 is Apache 2.0 and runs locally on a laptop
devstral-2.notes: The large model uses a modified MIT license; moved to a paid API in 2026-01, and Medium 3.5 took over as the main coding model in April.

ministral-3.tagline: A trio for phones and edge devices
